BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to animal disease traceability; and amending RCW16.36.023 and 16.36.025.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 16.36.023 and 2008 c 285 s 28 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director may adopt rules establishing fees for: (a) The establishment and inspection of animal holding facilitiesauthorized under this chapter; (b) The inspection and monitoring of animals in authorized animalholding facilities; ((and)) (c) Special inspections of animals or animal facilities that thedirector may provide at the request of the animal owner or interestedpersons; and (d) Providing services and support related to the provision ofregulatory forms and supplies distributed by the department includingofficial individual identification device or method, such as officialtags and radio frequency identification devices, that are approved bythe department for animals or groups of animals. In addition to anyamount collected for the actual cost of the device, a fee may be p. 1 SB 5759collected for each official individual identification device or methodthat is supplied. These fees shall be used to fund the cost ofservices and program support for the animal disease traceabilityfunctions of the department. (2) The fees shall, as closely as practicable, cover the cost ofthe service provided. (3) All fees collected under this section shall be deposited in anaccount in the agricultural local fund and used to carry out thepurposes of this chapter and chapter 16.57 RCW.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 16.36.025 and 1998 c 8 s 19 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director may collect moneys to recover the reasonable costs ofpurchasing, printing, and distributing ((certificates)) officialindividual identification devices or methods, regulatory forms, andother supplies ((to veterinarians)). All funds collected under thissection shall be deposited in an account in the agricultural local fundand used to carry out the purposes of this chapter and chapter 16.57RCW.
